description: Parkings sur le territoire de Grand Paris Seine Ouest is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Ce jeu de données contient des informations sur les parkings: surface, semi-enterré, souterrain, parkings partagés, nombre de places... Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are transport, voiture, voirie, parking, stationnement, issy.com. The portal shows 67 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2016-05-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
